description: Tether visual-link gate: spawn a line of hostiles, cast Vines on the nearest, and confirm the shared tether link renders between caster and target across the root/DoT duration (tether_link log lines from the line-control tick).
notes: Vines is a line_control tether (root+dot, 5s) targeting the nearest enemy; test mobs line spawns three Test_Dummy_Stationary in front.

The shared visual-link contract is asserted from [MOTM] tether_link log lines emitted by GameplayPlaybackManager.renderTetherLink (via TetherLinkRenderer) each line-control tick: a burst-only bead chain (Block_Break_Stone for terra) re-sampled between caster and target so it follows both endpoints (synced movement) and self-cleans when the tick stops (capped beads expire).
DoD: first shared tether visual-link (primitive-status P0 Pull/tether/carry), reusing the existing line-control functional runtime (pull/root/DoT).
